name: Hierarchical Out-of-Core Indexing for Orthogonal Slicing
aliases: Disk I/O complexity for grid slicing
Out-of-Core Complexity Analysis for Orthogonal Slicing
definition: Analysis of the number of data blocks transferred from disk for orthogonal slicing of 3D rectilinear grids, comparing standard row-major, $h \\times h \\times h$ blocking, and the proposed hierarchical scheme.
summary: Hierarchical Out-of-Core Indexing minimizes disk I/O for orthogonal slicing by using oct-tree or binary tree decomposition to maintain efficient block transfer complexity regardless of subsampling rate.
